explain.ko: 과거진행형(was / were + -ing)은 과거의 어느 시점에 진행 중이던 상황이나 배경을 나타내고, 과거형은 그 도중에 일어난 짧은 사건이나 끝난 동작을 나타냅니다. 'I was cooking when the phone rang.'처럼 when과 while을 연결어로 씁니다. while 뒤에는 보통 진행형이 오고, when 뒤에는 짧은 사건(과거형)이 자주 옵니다. 두 동작이 동시에 진행되었으면 둘 다 진행형입니다. know, like 같은 상태 동사는 진행형으로 쓰지 않습니다.
explain.en: The past continuous (was / were + -ing) describes a situation or background in progress at a moment in the past, while the past simple describes a short event or finished action that happened during it: 'I was cooking when the phone rang.' Use 'while' before a continuous action and 'when' before a short event. Two actions in progress at the same time are both continuous. State verbs such as know or like are not used in the continuous.

notes.ko: 긴 동작에는 과거진행형, 도중에 일어난 짧은 동작에는 과거형을 씁니다.
notes.en: Use the past continuous for the longer action and the past simple for the shorter one.

notes.ko: suddenly, all of a sudden은 갑작스러운 사건(과거형)과 함께 씁니다.
notes.en: Suddenly goes with a sudden event in the past simple.

notes.ko: 순서대로 일어난 사건은 모두 과거형입니다: He came in and sat down.
notes.en: Events in order are all past simple: He came in and sat down.
